title: Telangana Seeks Higher Tummidihatti Barrage
summary: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy met Union Jal Shakti Minister C.R. Patil in New Delhi on 5 August 2026 to seek Central intervention in the long-pending dispute with Maharashtra over the proposed height of the Tummidihatti barrage....

blocks.content: Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy met Union Jal Shakti Minister C.R. Patil in New Delhi on 5 August 2026 to seek Central intervention in the long-pending dispute with Maharashtra over the proposed height of the Tummidihatti barrage. The barrage is part of the Pranahita-Chevella irrigation project and is planned at Tummidihatti village in Kouthala mandal of the erstwhile Adilabad district on the Pranahita River.

items: The Pranahita River is part of the Godavari basin, which is one of India’s major river systems.
FRL means Full Reservoir Level and is a standard term in dam and barrage engineering.
tmcft stands for thousand million cubic feet and is used to measure large volumes of water.
Inter-state river water issues in India are often discussed under the framework of river basin planning and state-level agreements.
